critical_code_review_comments: Good: Email service properly handles SES SMTP with region detection and connection pooling
Good: Rate limiting at 10/sec is conservative (SES allows 14/sec)
Good: Retry queue with exponential backoff (max 5 retries, max 1hr backoff)
Good: IMAP poller runs as daemon thread with graceful stop
Good: Source badges correctly differentiate email vs portal messages in frontend
Good: Email threading uses In-Reply-To and References headers for proper Gmail threading
Note: Dashboard admin auth requires Google OAuth - source badges verified via code review only

context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Phase 2 fully implemented. Portal ticket creation triggers SES SMTP confirmation email (stored in email_threads with direction='outbound'). IMAP poller processes ~30 emails/cycle with proper dedup via message_id. Source badges work: 'via email' (teal) for IMAP replies, 'via portal' (gray) for portal replies. Agent reply (type='reply') and status change (resolved/closed/in_progress) both trigger customer notification emails. Rate limiting at 10/sec. Retry queue with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts. Admin dashboard requires Google OAuth so cannot automate those tests.
